## `neuro.set.values`

Instance method on `Set.prototype`.

> Returns an iterable of values in the set.

## Signatures

```ts
values(input: { set: <receiver>; prompt?: string }): Promise<SetIterator<T>>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Set.prototype.values` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
